g.text: Generator screen for all 22 series, and the nights at D15 and D18

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top three panels: for each series (only the series that are not Primary substations, and D15, are labelled), the share of its dark half-hours (CAMS irradiance below 1 W/m²) with power below zero against, in turn, the slope of its winter night level on daily-mean temperature, its median daily range as a share of effective capacity, and its median daily range divided by the absolute daily mean. Dashed line: the 1% flag. G-a and G-b are the two metered generators, shown with no dates. Bottom: the daily night mean of D15 and D18 and their sum, February 2025 to June 2026.'
text.tspan: Top three panels: for each series (only the series that are not Primary substations, and D15,
are labelled), the share of its dark half-hours (CAMS irradiance below 1 W/m²) with power below
zero against, in turn, the slope of its winter night level on daily-mean temperature, its
median daily range as a share of effective capacity, and its median daily range divided by the
absolute daily mean. Dashed line: the 1% flag. G-a and G-b are the two metered generators,
shown with no dates. Bottom: the daily night mean of D15 and D18 and their sum, February 2025
